note: Mexico, read in the Ley de Migración and the Ley Federal de Derechos (article 9, as reformed DOF 07-11-2025) and the Ley de Nacionalidad, each as the Chamber of Deputies publishes it (read 2026-10-30). Temporary residence lets a foreigner stay up to four years, with permission to work for pay subject to a job offer (the game reads that as work for the sponsor); it is applied for by visa at a consulate abroad. Its fee is $11,140.74 for up to one year, $16,693.36 for two, $21,142.58 for three and $25,057.82 for four; the term kept is one year, renewed at the same fee. After four years on temporary residence a foreigner may have permanent residence ($13,578.96), which allows work for pay. The separate fee for permission to work (article 9 III, $4,340.77, last reformed DOF 11-12-2013 in the text read) is left out, since the compiled text may not carry its annual update. Naturalisation asks five years' residence immediately before the application, so temporary and permanent years count. Family unity routes (spouse, children, parents of Mexicans) lead to permanent residence too and are not kept separately. Decision times are not in the laws; the Instituto Nacional de Migración's pages were not read.

sources.title: Ley de Migración (Cámara de Diputados, compiled text, read 2026-10-30)
sources.said: RESIDENTE TEMPORAL. Autoriza al extranjero para permanecer en el país por un tiempo no mayor a cuatro años, con la posibilidad de obtener un permiso para trabajar a cambio de una remuneración en el país, sujeto a una oferta de empleo ... V. Porque hayan transcurrido cuatro años desde que el extranjero cuenta con un permiso de residencia temporal; ... RESIDENTE PERMANENTE. Autoriza al extranjero para permanecer en el territorio nacional de manera indefinida, con permiso para trabajar a cambio de una remuneración en el país.
